opening_message:
Ticket 1: Anita Young (employee ID E001) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E001.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Anita is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting admin access to Payroll. Since Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, full-time employees may have admin. Recommend admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Anita Young (E001) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin exceeds maximum, so recommend read.
reason: Conflicting employee facts: HR states Anita is a full-time Payroll Specialist (which would allow admin since the role owns Payroll), but Security states she is a contractor with only basic training (contractors are never admin; maximum read). Given the conflicting employment-type evidence, I grant the level that is compliant under both interpretations: read is at or below the maximum under either set of facts and never exceeds the requested admin level.
